owner_adoption.question: Do you confirm authority to license the original prose and illustrations in the reviewed 20-file documentation selection—including controlled reference expression in the generated three-state image—and adopt CC BY 4.0 as Anthony Siljeg? This permits redistribution, commercial reuse and adaptations with attribution. Your company/founder/initiative attribution is included. Architecture documents, code/report artifacts, datasets, models, full archives, policy/provenance records and future wrapper files remain outside this new grant; existing code/report grants stay unchanged and both repositories remain private.
owner_adoption.answer: Yes—adopt CC BY 4.0 for the reviewed 20-file documentation content.

attribution_choice.answer: Yes—keep Anthony as licensor and add those attribution details.
